rounds.title: Teacher feedback
rounds.text: Rounds in which students or guardians rate the teachers who teach them, and what they found.
rounds.privacy: Ratings are kept without names. A teacher's averages and comments show only once {count} people rated them.
rounds.empty_text: Open a round for a term: families rate each subject teacher in the portal, and you see the averages here.
rounds.open_text: {who} can rate from its first day. Once open, the questions and name stay as they are; only the last day can move.
rounds.close_text: Nobody can rate after this. The results stay.

dialog.title: New feedback round
dialog.text: Saved as a draft. Open it when families should start rating.
dialog.open_text: This round is open: only its last day can move.

fields.name: Name
fields.dates: The last day must be on or after the first day.

results.not_enough: {count} rated so far. Results show from {min} ratings, so nobody can be picked out.
results.approved: Comment approved: the teacher sees it now.
results.empty_text: Ratings show here as families send them in the portal.
results.not_found: That round does not exist here.

mine.title: My feedback
mine.text: What students or guardians said about your teaching, round by round.
mine.privacy: You never see who rated you. Averages and comments show once {count} people rated you for a subject.
mine.not_teacher: You are not a teacher here
mine.not_teacher_text: Your login is not linked to a teacher (an employee in Human resources). Ask the office.
mine.empty_text: When a round opens and families rate you, your results show here.

portal.title: Rate the teachers
portal.text: Teachers of {name}, in the rounds open now.
portal.anonymous: Your rating is kept without your name. Teachers see only averages from many people.
portal.comment_hint: What goes well, what could be better. Do not write names or phone numbers.
portal.thanks: Thank you. Your rating is kept without your name.
portal.none_text: When the school opens a feedback round, the teachers to rate show here.

conflict: Someone changed this round a moment ago. It is fresh now; try again.
